summary: Sigma Lithium filed a Form 6-K with a press release celebrating safety milestones (1,010 days without lost-time injury, zero fatalities in 14 years) and reaffirming production guidance of 240,000 tpy lithium oxide concentrate. It denies inaccurate media reports regarding waste piles being banned by Brazil's Ministry of Labor, citing an official technical statement from mining regulator ANM attesting their safety. The filing is a routine operational update and response to media; no special-situation transaction is announced. No deal terms, advisors, board recommendations, or structural mechanics are present. The filing is a periodic report from a foreign private issuer and does not trigger a special situation category.
